chunks: ʿAlī narrated from his father, from al-Nawfalī, from al-Sakūnī, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:

Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام said: “If a man’s speech is the speech of women, and his manner of walking is the manner of women, and he makes himself available so that he is penetrated as a woman is penetrated, then stone him and do not be ashamed concerning him.”

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Title of Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام, the Commander of the Faithful
key_terms.كَلَامُهُ: his speech or manner of speaking
key_terms.لَا تَسْتَحْيُوهُ: do not feel shame or hesitation regarding carrying this out
key_terms.مِشْيُهُ: his gait or manner of walking

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling in Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām on a man who is penetrated like a woman?
ai.summary: This hadith conveys a legal ruling attributed to Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام regarding a man described as taking the passive role in illicit same-sex intercourse. Its significance in the text is juridical, presenting a prescribed hadd punishment within the framework of Islamic criminal law discussed in the chapter.
